title: USF Provider Mode Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for provider mode declarations. Records the declared provider class (provider-modes) for a provider/adapter fulfilling a port, keeping provider mode distinct from environment (environment-classes). Enforces that hermetic-mock MUST NOT satisfy a live-external-provider claim (Charter §6); a mock IdP is valid hermetic proof only. Governs the ontology concepts Provider, Provider Mode, Adapter, and Port. lifecycleState draft; not active.

port.$comment: The port (semantic boundary) this provider fulfils.

adapter.$comment: The adapter binding the provider to the port.

environment.$comment: Separate dimension; environment MUST NOT upgrade provider mode by implication.

allOf.$comment: hermetic-mock MUST NOT satisfy a live-external-provider claim.
A live-external-provider claim is only honest when the declared mode is live-external-provider.
